paragraphs.en: Chart embedded in “The Sunday Scaries Are Real—And They're Getting Worse.” Title: “Share of Sundays spent on...” Legend: Chat and messaging; Admin and IT; Business management; Email; Research and reference. Periods: 2023–24; 2024–25; 2025–26. Note: Work activity data for employees at 336 companies. Data captures activity over a 24-hour period on monitored devices only. Source: ActivTrak.
